messages:
Lia: Heads-up — Nimbus pilot wants an enterprise preview in 3 weeks. We need a quick scope decision: what absolutely must land in MVP vs what can move to v1?
Sam: timeline is tight. Is the ask just SSO + basic telemetry or also on-prem packaging?
Lia: SSO + region pinning + audit logs for the pilot. They also asked for per-route cost breakdown and embeddings cache hot-warm tier, but those could be v1.
Jordan: On-prem packaging is non-trivial. If Nimbus needs a private bundle, that likely pushes us 6+ weeks. Can we offer a hosted dedicated instance in a GDPR region as a stopgap?
Priya: From UX, SSO + simple onboarding flow is enough for the pilot. Audit log UX can be trimmed: provide CSV export instead of full console for v1.
Mohit: Technical risk: embeddings cache hot-warm adds memory pressure and KV migration work. We can ship a single-tier cache for MVP and document perf caveats.
Lia: Sounds like candidate split: MVP = SSO, region pinning, basic audit logs (CSV), hosted dedicated instance; V1 = on-prem bundle, multi-tier cache, per-route cost retention, richer console views. Agree?
Sam: Agree but callout: model pinning + fallback policy for low-latency SLOs needs to be in MVP or else Nimbus will see inconsistent latency.
Mohit: We can provide model pinning with a clear compatibility table. Fallback to smaller model is doable. That's a must for MVP.
Jordan: Operational checklist for MVP (proposed):
- dedicated pool in eu-west
- SSO SAML test pass
- model pinning + fallback verified under 10k RPS loadtest
- 95p latency < 350ms for 8k token bursts
- audit CSV export available
- docs + onboarding script for tenant setup
(Lia: add canary plan)
Lia: Canary plan: roll to 5% traffic for 24h, 50% for 48h, then full. Gate: no P0 errors on canary and latency SLI within threshold. Ops to trigger rollback if error rate > 1% or 95p latency degrades 30% vs baseline.
Jordan: I'll take loadtests and canary automation. Sam, can you own SSO + onboarding scripts?
Sam: Yep. Sam: I'll prototype SAML flow by EOD Friday.
Priya: I'll draft a trimmed audit CSV UX and onboarding checklist for the Nimbus customer success team.
Mohit: I'll scope the cache single-tier implementation + fallback model. Estimate 5 dev-days.
Lia: New milestone plan: freeze MVP scope in 48h, then 10 working days to implement canary-ready artifacts, then pilot handoff. If any critical infra blocker appears, we formally reset to +2 weeks.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: dedicated-eu pipeline has 1 pending infra change (network ACL). Jordan, please triage before Friday to avoid rolling delay.
Jordan: Noted, I'll triage today.
Sam: Quick Q — acceptance criteria for SSO: full end-to-end login from Nimbus tenant + admin consent flow?
Lia: Yes — admin SAML SSO + user login + at least one role mapping. Document test steps in the PR.
Priya: Suggest adding a short customer demo script to acceptance criteria so Nimbus PM can exercise basic flows during pilot.
Lia: Good call. I'll add demo script and scheduled demo to the handoff checklist.
Mohit: One more: telemetry retention for MVP can be 7 days. We'll call out next steps for 30/90-day retention in v1 scope doc.
Lia: Final action list:
- Lia: finalize MVP vs v1 split and share with Nimbus (today)
- Sam: SSO prototype by EOD Fri
- Jordan: triage ACL + run loadtests
- Priya: onboarding + demo script
- Mohit: cache single-tier + model pinning work plan
- Ops: confirm dedicated eu infra change deadline
Lia: If no major objections by EOD, I'll freeze and ship the scope doc to Nimbus PM. :shipit:
Sam: No objections from Eng here. :+1:
Jordan: Same.
Priya: ✅
Mohit: 👍
ops-bot: Reminder set: pilot-handshake-check at 1754410000
Lia: Thanks team — moving to action.
